translations.web: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
translations.bsb: ‘Cursed is he who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ And let all the people say, ‘Amen!’
translations.kjv: Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.
translations.asv: Cursed be he that taketh a bribe to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.
